definitions: NATO, ICAO, ITU & IMO radiotelephony clear code (spelling-alphabet name) for  thousand.
A numerical value equal to 1,000; ten times a hundred (1 E+3 exactly—in scientific E notation)
Alternative name for conchiglie, a type of pasta.
third-person singular simple present indicative of shell

blocks.text: 1000 or one thousand is the natural number following 999 and preceding 1001. In most English-speaking countries, it can be written with or without a comma or sometimes a period separating the thousands digit: 1,000.
